Name: Baldur's Gate 3 - Enver Gortash Replacement Mod
Author: Lyroux912
Description:
[font=Arial][center][size=4]
[color=#d9d2e9]Ever felt your farm life lacked a Gortash? Either way, you can get one now.[/color][/size][/center]

﻿I made this mod with personal use in mind, but after enjoying it with my friends for a while, I might as well share him here. It's my first time ever dabbling in modmaking for any game, but I hope you enjoy either way.
﻿﻿It's a simple replacement mod that uses CP to swap out Sebastian with Enver Gortash from Baldur's Gate 3! All sprites and visuals made by me, also including custom dialogue lines for both married and not. He keeps Sebastian's schedule and heart events, but with text edited to suit his personality better.
[/font]
[center][size=4][b]He is, therefore, romancable![/b][/size][/center]
Additional things I've changed up include a spouse portrait, weapon, and a little change to some critters to fit in with his heart event.

[center][size=4]I've also altered his room, but due to my limited modding knowledge, [b]it works in a way that replaces all textures of that kind that appear in the game.[/b] I currently don't have the knowledge on how to work around that, so I'm including a file that keeps his room as is.[/size][/center][size=3][b]Instructions:[/b]
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=files]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files/]Content Patcher[/url] by Pathoschild
2. Unzip Content Patcher into your Mods folder
3. Download and unzip this mod into the Mods folder

[b]His loved gifts include: [/b]
Battery Pack
Gold/Iridium Bar
Pufferfish
Roasted Hazelnuts
Super Cucumber
Triple Shot Espresso
Void Egg
Void Essence[/size]
